Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 모든 것이 부질없다고 자조한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> self-deprecatingly laments that everything is pointless.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、すべてが無駄だと自嘲する。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>自嘲地说一切都是徒劳。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>自嘲地說一切都是徒勞。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après l'échec de la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se lamente avec autodérision que tout est vain.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach dem Scheitern der Mission beklagt sich <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> selbstironisch, dass alles sinnlos ist.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se lamenta con autodesprecio de que todo es inútil.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lamenta que tudo é inútil, com autodepreciação.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากทำภารกิจไม่สำเร็จ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็คร่ำครวญอย่างตัดพ้อว่าทุกอย่างไร้ค่า
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencela diri sendiri bahwa semuanya sia-sia.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tự ti than thở rằng mọi thứ đều vô nghĩa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुद को कोसते हुए कहता है कि सब कुछ व्यर्थ है।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> didn't seem intent on arguing the point.

Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> no parecía tener intención de negarlo.

Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ไหล่ตกและเดินจากไปอย่างหมดแรง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> merosotkan bahunya dan berjalan pergi dengan langkah berat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thả lỏng vai, bước đi mệt mỏi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के कंधे झुक गए और वह भारी कदमों से चला गया।

Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
